limitations: CraftedNBA credits no measurement source and doesn't say whether heights are with or without shoes; its values are labelled reported, never combine-measured.
Reported values stay out of percentiles, positional averages and the registered correlations.
The combine's measurement wins wherever a player has both.
Names are matched to NBA person IDs; a name that fits several players and can't be settled by DARKO's board on the seal date is left out and listed.

credits: Design reference: Databallr's Wingspan page (databallr.com), replicated with its owner's approval for a non-commercial portfolio.
Measurements: NBA Draft Combine (NBA.com), through hoopR (sportsdataverse).
caveats: Descriptive association, not a prediction and not a cause. DARKO's season-end boards are retrospective ratings that include each season's own games.
Career D-DPM is the minutes-weighted mean of season-end D-DPM over seasons with at least 500 regular-season minutes, 2000-01 to 2025-26.
Only combine participants since 2000 who played a 500-minute season enter the correlations; players who skipped the combine are absent, so this is not the whole league.
Positions are the first listed combine position (SG-SF is SG), not current roles.
A missing measurement or rating is unknown, never zero.
An r is called positive or negative only when its 95% interval excludes zero.

Players the combine never measured show CraftedNBA's reported height and wingspan, labelled Reported. CraftedNBA names no measurement source; where both exist its heights match the combine's barefoot height for most players, and the combine's figure is always the one shown.
Reported players have no percentiles and stay out of the positional averages, the correlations and the career D-DPM population.
